Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Himanshu Bansal, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

2. This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred against the order dated 04.05.2024, passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate VII, Meerut in Case No.15954 of 2019 (State Vs. Praful and others), arising out of Case Crime No.577 of 2019, under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station- Brahmpuri, District- Meerut, whereby the application filed by applicant for discharge has been rejected.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that impugned order is against facts and law and thus, liable to be set aside.
The trial Court has not considered the matter in correct perspective.

In the first information report, the informant has made allegation that on 08.09.2019 her brother-in-law (devar), namely, Prateek Garg has molested her but on that date the location of informant was found at her parental home and the said incident was found false.

Referring to first information report, it was submitted that allegations made in the first information report, are wholly false and improbable and the alleged medical examination report of victim/informant is also a false document.
The police have not conducted investigation properly and charge-sheet was submitted without any evidence.
There is long delay in lodging of the first information report.

It was submitted that the allegations levelled by applicant are wholly false and no prima-facie case for framing of charges is made out but the trial court has not considered the matter in accordance with law and the discharge application was rejected in arbitrary manner.

4. Learned AGA and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 have opposed the application and submitted that applicant is husband of the informant and there are clear allegations that she was harassed on account of dowry and on 13.01.2019 she was assaulted by the applicant.
In medical examination report, five injuries have been shown on body of informant.
It was submitted that the trial Court has considered all attending facts and rejected the discharge application by a reasoned order.
It was also submitted that instead of filing a revision, applicant has filed this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C., which is not maintainable.
5. I have considered the rival submissions and perused the record.
6. It is well settled that while considering discharge application, the Court is to exercise its judicial mind to determine whether a case for trial has been made out or not.
At this stage, a mini trial cannot be held and the Court can shift and weigh the evidence for limited purpose of finding out whether or not a prima facie case against the accused is made out or not.
Where material placed on record discloses grave suspicion against the accused, which has not been properly explained, the Court will be fully justified in rejecting application for discharge.
The Court is not to hold mini trial by marshalling the evidence at this stage.
7. In the instant case, perusal of record shows that applicant is husband of informant/opposite party no.2.
In the first information report, there are clear allegations that applicant has harassed the informant on account of dowry and on 13.01.2019 he has assaulted her.
In medical examination report, five injuries have been shown on body of informant.
In view of allegations levelled in the first information report and statement of informant, it could not be said that no prima-facie case for charges is made out.
The trial Court has rejected the discharge application by considering all relevant facts and passed a reasoned order.
There is no such material illegality or perversity in the impugned order so as to require any interference by this Court by invoking powers under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. lacks merit and thus, liable to be dismissed.
8. The application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is hereby dismissed.
